title: Gauge
description: A single value on an arc, against a range and optional colored thresholds: KPIs, usage, scores. Changing value animates the arc (and the needle) from its current position.

support.notes: Chart component of minerva-design/native: the canvas chart engine drawn with views (touch scrub, pinch zoom, legend toggles).

api.notes: Chart component of minerva-design/native: the canvas chart engine drawn with views (touch scrub, pinch zoom, legend toggles).

props.name: value
props.description: Value shown by the arc (clamped to `min` - `max` for the drawing)

props.name: min
props.description: Value at the start of the arc

props.name: max
props.description: Value at the end of the arc

props.name: label
props.description: Caption under the value

props.name: sweep
props.description: Total angle of the arc, degrees

props.name: thickness
props.description: Thickness of the arc as a fraction of the radius

props.name: bands
props.description: Colored ranges of the track; the value arc takes the color of its band

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the value arc (when there are no bands)

props.name: needle
props.description: Draws a needle in addition to the value arc

props.name: ticks
props.description: Tick labels at the ends (and at the band bounds)

props.name: palette
props.description: Colors of the marks without `color` (defaults to the `chart-series-1..8` tokens, then the theme colors)

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend; tapping an item hides / shows its slice, stage, series, node, bar, row or level

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip shown while a mark is pressed; `false` disables it

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the values of the labels and the tooltip

props.name: percentFormat
props.description: Formats the shares (labels, conversion rates, tooltip); `share` is 0-1

props.name: hidden
props.description: Hidden slices / stages / radar series / top-level treemap or sunburst nodes / sankey nodes / radial bars / bullet rows / calendar levels, by index. Makes the visibility controlled: legend taps then only call `onToggle`, whose `hiddenIndexes` should be stored and passed back.

props.name: animation
props.description: Entry and update animations (skipped when the theme reduces motion)

props.name: padding
props.description: Space around the drawing, in pixels

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the chart

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale of the built-in texts (tooltip rows, accessible names, "No data") and of the numbers

props.name: texts
props.description: Replaces built-in texts of the `locale`

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the chart (the legend included)

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the chart

props.name: renderTooltip
props.description: React content of the tooltip (replaces the default content)

props.name: testID
props.description: Test identifier of the root view

events.name: onHover
events.description: Called when the highlighted mark changes (press and drag over the chart)

events.name: onClick
events.description: Called when a mark is tapped

events.name: onToggle
events.description: Called when a legend item is tapped (or the instance's `toggle()` is called), with the toggled index and every hidden index after the toggle

examples.title: Bands and needle
examples.description: bands colors the track by range (red, amber, green) and the value arc takes the color of its band; needle points at the value, min can be negative.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: Three small gauges with their own color, label and format.

translationResources.title: Gauge
translationResources.description: A single value on an arc, against a range and optional colored thresholds: KPIs, usage, scores. Changing value animates the arc (and the needle) from its current position.

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: Three small gauges with their own color, label and format.

bands.title: Bands and needle
bands.description: bands colors the track by range (red, amber, green) and the value arc takes the color of its band; needle points at the value, min can be negative.

live.title: Live value
live.description: A timer updates value every 1.5 s and the gauge animates to it; sweep={180} draws a half circle and thickness widens the arc. The timer is cleared when paused or unmounted.

speedometer.title: Speedometer
speedometer.description: A thin arc with a needle; hold the buttons (or Space / Enter) to accelerate or brake. animation={false} lets the needle follow the state directly, and the unit comes from Intl.NumberFormat.

quota.title: Quota usage
quota.description: One gauge per plan quota with bands at 75% and 90% of each limit, ticks={false} and a caption with the used and allowed amounts.

slo.title: Availability and error budget
slo.description: A zoomed gauge (min 99.5, max 100) shows the availability against its objective, a second one the error budget left; renderTooltip gives the details.

thermostat.title: Smart thermostat
thermostat.description: The − and + buttons move the target by half a degree; the setting is stored in °C and converted for display, so switching to °F changes value, min, max and the bands together. renderTooltip shows the room temperature and the line below whether the system heats, cools or holds.

credit-score.title: Credit score
credit-score.description: A needle on five rating bands from 300 to 850, with min and max set to the scale of the score. A Select switches applicants and the needle sweeps to the new score; renderTooltip names the rating and event.percent gives the position on the scale.

battery.title: Electric car charging
battery.description: A half gauge (sweep={180}) fills every 400 ms while plugged in, more slowly above 80 %; the interval stops when unplugged, full or unmounted. Only the charging phase is announced; the range and the time to 80 % come from Intl.NumberFormat units.

dark-panel.title: Dark control panel
dark-panel.description: Three needle gauges on a panel whose CSS variables switch to a dark theme. The charts only watch <html> and <body>, so after restyling the container the demo calls refreshTheme() on each chart through its ref.

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: One value on a 240° arc; format writes it as a percent.

bands.title: Bands and needle
bands.description: bands color the track and the value arc; the buttons change value and the arc and the needle animate to it.

bands.title: Colored bands

needle.title: Needle and custom scale
needle.description: A needle over a 0–200 scale, with a wider sweep and a thinner arc.

props.height: Height of the chart, the legend included: pixels or any CSS length
props.options: Other engine options (axes, legend, tooltip, palette, format…) merged with the element's own properties; property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) mark changed; detail: { index, name, value, share }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-click: A mark was clicked, tapped or activated with Enter; detail: { index, name, value, share }
events.minerva-toggle: A legend item was clicked (or toggle() called); detail: { index, hidden, hiddenIndexes }

methods.toggle: Hides / shows a slice, stage, radar series or top-level treemap node by index
methods.getRenderer: Backend drawing the shapes (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d), null until ready; set it with the renderer engine option
